info.title: API.SH: Vestiaire Collective
info.description: The Vestiaire Collective API from API.SH: public Vestiaire Collective data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A brand's pre-owned listings on Vestiaire Collective, 48 a page: the brand (id, name, listing count) plus the same products, facets and price range as search. Give the brand by name or by Vestiaire's brand id; every search filter (category, condition, color, price range, sold...), `q`, `sort` and `locale` also apply. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/vestiairecollective-brand

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand name (e.g. hermes, saint laurent) or Vestiaire brand id (e.g. 50).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords within the brand.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category id (from `facets.categoryLvl0`).

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Condition id (from `facets.condition`).

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Lowest price, in the locale's currency.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Highest price, in the locale's currency.

parameters.name: sold
parameters.description: Sold items only, or unsold only.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Storefront (prices, currency and item names).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Vestiaire Collective category's pre-owned listings, 48 a page: the category (name, level, and each matching id with its universe, listing count and parent) plus the same products, facets and price range as search. Give a category (Bags, Clothing, Shoes...) or a subcategory (Handbags, Jackets...) by name or id; categories exist per universe (women, men, kids) and a name covers all of them unless `universe` is given. Leave category out to get every universe with its categories, subcategories and listing counts. Every search filter (brand, condition, color, price range, sold...), `q`, `sort` and `locale` also apply. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/vestiairecollective-category

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category or subcategory name (e.g. bags, handbags, sneakers) or id. Leave out to list the categories.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords within the category.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand id (from `facets.brand`).

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Condition id (from `facets.condition`).

parameters.name: universe
parameters.description: Universe id: 1 women, 2 men, 3 kids.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Lowest price, in the locale's currency.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Highest price, in the locale's currency.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Storefront (prices, currency and item names).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Pre-owned luxury listings matching keywords, 48 a page, with the search facets and price range. Filter by brand, condition, color, category, subcategory, model, material, pattern, size, universe, seller country, sold, duty-free, editor picks and a price range; `locale` sets the storefront (prices, currency and item names). Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/vestiairecollective-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords. May be left out when a filter (brand, category, ...) is given, to list everything it matches.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), price-asc, price-desc, recency.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand id(s), e.g. 50 (Chanel). Ids, names and counts for the current search are in the response `facets`.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Condition id(s): 1 never worn with tag, 2 never worn, 3 very good, 4 good, 5 fair. Ids, names and counts for the current search are in the response `facets`.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Color id(s). Ids, names and counts for the current search are in the response `facets`.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Top category id(s), e.g. 5 (Bags). Ids, names and counts for the current search are in the response `facets`.

parameters.name: universe
parameters.description: 1 women, 2 men, 3 kids. Ids, names and counts for the current search are in the response `facets`.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Seller country code(s), e.g. US, FR. Ids, names and counts for the current search are in the response `facets`.

parameters.name: sold
parameters.description: 0 for sale, 1 sold. Ids, names and counts for the current search are in the response `facets`.

parameters.name: duty_free
parameters.description: 1 for duty-free items. Ids, names and counts for the current search are in the response `facets`.

parameters.name: editor_picks
parameters.description: e.g. Vintage, We love. Ids, names and counts for the current search are in the response `facets`.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Model id(s), e.g. 7602 (Chanel Boy). Ids, names and counts for the current search are in the response `facets`.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Pattern id(s), e.g. 4 (Tartan). Ids are in the response `facets`.

parameters.name: material
parameters.description: Material id(s), e.g. 3 (Leather), 18 (Tweed). Ids are in the response `facets` (materialLvl0).

parameters.name: subcategory
parameters.description: Subcategory id(s), e.g. 59 (Handbags), 526 (Backpacks). Ids are in the response `facets` (categoryLvl1).

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size id(s), as in each item's `raw.size.id`.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Lowest price, in the locale's currency (e.g. 500).

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Highest price, in the locale's currency.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Storefront for prices, currency and item names: us (default, USD), uk (GBP), fr, de, it, es (EUR), hk (HKD).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Vestiaire Collective seller by id or profile link: name, username, country, professional flag, badges, description, items sold, items listed, usual shipping time, followers, following, liked items, community rank, vacation flag, photo and link. Followers, following and community rank are filled when available.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/vestiairecollective-seller

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A vestiairecollective.com profile link, instead of `id`.

get.description:
A Vestiaire Collective seller's listings, 48 per page, with sort and a sold filter: id, name, brand, model, price, currency, discount, sold flag, likes, size, colours, country, listing date, description, shipping flag, link and photos, with the total. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/vestiairecollective-seller-items

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The seller's numeric id, e.g. 4085582.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A vestiairecollective.com profile link, instead of `id`.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), price-asc or price-desc.

parameters.name: sold
parameters.description: true: only sold items; false: only items still for sale; omit for both.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
